records.claim: Miscarriage is common and can occur in any pregnancy for many different reasons. Studies have not been done in women to see if semaglutide can increase the chance of miscarriage. Animal studies have reported a higher chance of miscarriage; however, it is unclear if this finding was due to the medication or from weight loss. As there can be many causes of miscarriage, it is hard to know if the medication, the medical condition, or other factors are the cause of a miscarriage.
